## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev` (feature work) or is an intentional `dev → main` release PR
- [ ] Builds locally in Release (`dotnet build -c Release`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`dotnet test`)
- [ ] No new deprecated/vulnerable dependencies (`dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive`)
- [ ] Version bumped if this is a release (tag / package version)
- [ ] Store "What's new" / CHANGELOG updated (release PRs only)
